token_provenance.canvas: most-frequent pixel color across sampled frames of docs/demo.gif -- the tool's real rendered TUI background
token_provenance.ink: assembled near-white, cool-toned to match the accent family -- the terminal's literal rendered foreground sampled at ~luma 190-210, too dim to clear the dark-canvas ink floor (>=230 luma), so lifted at the token per the browser-use (2026-07-04b) precedent
token_provenance.accent: dominant saturated pixel color in the official assets/png/mcpsnoop-lockup.png wordmark (#1fb6ff, hue 200deg) -- the author's own rendered logo color

readability_plan.ink_floor: dark canvas, primary ink >= 230 luma (#f2f6f8 clears this at contrast 16.69:1)
readability_plan.accent_as_graphic: raw #1fb6ff stays on the shader field, split-panel fills, teal-flagged status text, and the flash burst; any text-scale accent use relies on build_html's auto-derived --accent-ink
readability_plan.muted_carries_content: panes activity lines and detail rows use --muted-content, not raw --ink-muted
readability_plan.light_per_scene: panes (beat 1): calm bright pane chrome on dark canvas. two_line (beat 2): accent-lit second line under rack focus. terminal (beat 3): bright ink body, prompt-line accent. split (beat 4, money shot): mcpsnoop-side panel lifts to a bright teal-accented fill against the dim inspector side, the frame's brightest moment. flash (beat 5): full-bleed sky-blue accent field with cool near-white type, the second bright beat. close (beat 6): bright hero thesis line on dark canvas.
readability_plan.inverted_beats: split (beat 4, right panel only) and flash (beat 5, full field) are the two color-break bright beats -- roughly a third of the runtime reads bright, clearing the frame brightness floor by design rather than in the grade
